Name: LinkWindow
Author: kaniclub
Description:
[center][size=6][b]LinkWindow[/b][/size]
[i]Connect windows. Customize their look. Enjoy the view.[/i][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53931/53931-1792138961-427202235.gif[/img][/center]

LinkWindow adds [b]one-tile wall windows that connect automatically[/b] when placed next to each other.

Build a window that fits your room, then customize its frame, size, shape, and grid. With TrueWindow, your connected windows can display real-time outdoor scenery or custom images.

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Connecting windows[/b]
Place windows next to each other horizontally or vertically to form a connected group.[/*]
[*][b]Frame materials[/b]
Choose a wooden frame, metal frame, or no frame. Wood and metal styles are designed to blend with vanilla furniture.[/*]
[*][b]Two sizes[/b]
Choose Large or Medium. Medium windows leave more wallpaper visible around the edges.[/*]
[*][b]Customizable shapes[/b]
Switch between square and rounded shapes using eight controls arranged around the preview. Each corner has two independent controls. Round all eight to create a circular or elliptical window.[/*]
[*][b]Adjustable grids[/b]
Set vertical and horizontal bar counts independently with minus and plus buttons. Set either count to zero for vertical-only, horizontal-only, or grid-free windows.[/*]
[*][b]TrueWindow integration[/b]
Display outdoor scenery, built-in image presets, or your own images.[/*]
[*][b]Configurable settings key[/b]
Change the default F6 key through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53931/53931-1792137783-272646690.png[/img][/center]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]TrueWindow[/*]
[*]Content Patcher, required by TrueWindow[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Install the required mods.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded archive and place the LinkWindow folder in your game's Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Getting Started[/b][/size]

Get [b]LinkWindow[/b] from the regular [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b] for free.

Place the windows on a wall. Adjacent windows connect automatically.

Hover over a placed window and press [b]F6[/b] to open its customization menu. Changes apply to the entire connected group and appear immediately. The group being edited is highlighted while the menu is open.

Your settings are saved with your game.

[size=5][b]Changing the View[/b][/size]

[b]Right-click a window[/b] to open TrueWindow's display settings.

Choose outdoor scenery or an image, then adjust the position and zoom to suit your room.

Frame, shape, size, and grid settings apply to each connected group. TrueWindow's display settings are shared by all TrueWindow-enabled windows in the same location.

[size=5][b]Using Your Own Images[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Place PNG, JPG, or JPEG images directly inside [b]Mods/LinkWindow/images[/b].[/*]
[*]Restart the game.[/*]
[*]Right-click a window and choose the image filename in TrueWindow's display source setting.[/*]
[/list]
You can add multiple images. Keep filenames unchanged to preserve saved selections.

[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Each window occupies one tile. Transparent areas around rounded or Medium windows do not provide additional furniture placement space.[/*]
[*]Windows can also connect in L-shaped arrangements. Shape and grid settings use the rectangle enclosing the entire group as their reference.[/*]
[*]Very dense grids are limited by the available pixels.[/*]
[*]Window customization is available to the host only. Multiplayer behavior has not been fully tested.[/*]
[/list]
